title: CD Supervisor: model onboarding build, cryptographic signing, and staged performance-release
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description:
Summary: Build a lightweight 'CD Supervisor' pipeline that automates model onboarding builds, cryptographic signing (cosign + transparency ledger), SBOM generation, performance profile publication, and staged rollout orchestration to the release registry. This ticket implements the glue and safety checks required to go from a validated model artifact to a pinned, throttled production profile with automatic rollback hooks.

Background: Currently onboarding relies on a mix of manual scripts and ad-hoc CI steps maintained in several repos. This causes inconsistent metadata, missed SBOMs, and fragile rollouts when profiles diverge from observed latency/throughput. We need a repeatable pipeline that produces signed artifacts, canonical manifests, and coordinates a canary performance release that ties into the release-broker.

Goals: 1) Single CI workflow (benchdog) that produces: model artifact, SBOM, performance profile JSON, and cryptographic signature + transparency entry. 2) Publish artifacts to the release registry with an immutable pin and optional staged tag (canary -> ramp -> GA). 3) Gate release if profile regression or SBOM issues are detected. 4) Provide clear telemetry and rollback controls surfaced in Console.

Acceptance criteria: - New pipeline run creates: artifact.tar.gz, artifact.sbom.json, perf-profile-v1.json, artifact.sig (cosign), and rekor transparency entry. - Release registry records pin and staged tag; Console shows release in 'staged' state with token-level cost and latency estimates. - Canary rollout automatically routes 1% traffic for 24h then 10% for 12h, unless perf regressions are reported. - On failure, pipeline triggers fast rollback and notifies SRE + PM channels. - End-to-end test (CI) simulates perf regression and verifies rollback path.

Design decisions: - Signing: use cosign for signatures and Rekor for transparency ledger; maintain rekor entries keyed by artifact digest. - Distribution: use current release-registry API (immutable pins + staged tags) and extend metadata to include 'benchdog_profile_id' and 'sbom_digest'. - Benchmarking: integrate 'benchdog' (new harness) to produce percentile latencies, throughput curves, and tail-latency histograms used to compute pass/fail thresholds. - Rollout controller: small state machine in pipeline that updates release-registry and calls RouterService for traffic shifts; if thresholds break, controller triggers release-broker reversion.

Architecture notes: Steps in pipeline: 1) Build (hermetic builder image) -> produce artifact.tar.gz and model-metadata.json. 2) SBOM generation (syft) -> artifact.sbom.json. 3) Benchmark (benchdog) -> perf-profile-v1.json and metrics snapshot. 4) Sign artifact with cosign -> artifact.sig and publish rekor entry. 5) Publish to release-registry with pin and staged tag. 6) Initiate canary via release-broker; monitor metrics for 36h window. 7) On pass, promote staged tag to pinned release.

Risks & mitigations: - Risk: benchdog instability yields false regressions. Mitigation: run 3 independent benchdog runs and median results; require two-pass threshold check. - Risk: signing key compromise. Mitigation: use KMS-bound cosign key with HSM key access and rotate keys quarterly. - Risk: race between release-broker and RouterService during traffic shifts. Mitigation: add idempotent operations and safety timeouts with abort path.

Telemetry & alerting: - Emit events to Console: pipeline.start, pipeline.step.completed, transparency.entry.created, staged.release.started, staged.release.metrics, staged.release.rolledback. - Create a Grafana dashboard (perf-onboard-ENG-98214) showing perf-profile trends, canary error budget, and token-cost delta.

Docs & artifacts: see artifacts field for links.

Next steps: - Migrate two pilot models (open-vicuna-13b, redwood-base-2) to run through supervisor. - Add CI job to verify SBOM schema and rekor entry. - Schedule security review and run key-rotation drill in staging.
